# FG-KNOW-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`knowledge`](../../ops/runbooks/knowledge.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `provision_failure_leaves_no_link` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: Wiki を作れませんでした。管理者に問い合わせ番号を伝えてください。
- en: The wiki could not be created. Give the request ID to your administrator.
- id: Wiki tidak dapat dibuat. Berikan ID permintaan kepada administrator Anda.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 20 W2 (ADR-0040 §5): `POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/wiki` created the wiki project, but a later step failed, so the wiki was NOT linked (nobody inherits a role on it): `step=provision` (the repository could not be created or marked ready), `step=seed` (the first commit with `.forge/doctypes/wiki.page.yml` and `WIKI-0001.md` could not be written, or `main` already existed), `step=protect` (the default protection of `main` could not be set), `step=link` (the link could not be written — also when a concurrent request linked another wiki first, chained FG-KNOW-0003). The cause is chained (FG-GIT-*, FG-REPO-*, FG-DB-*).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `step`, `project_id` (the owner), `wiki_project_id` (the half-made project), `repo_id` and the chained code, with the request_id. The project exists and is unlinked: `SELECT * FROM forge.project_wikis WHERE wiki_project_id = <id>` returns nothing.

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the chained cause (runbooks repository-provisioning, git-process-failed, db-unavailable). Then the person deletes the half-made project and runs `gstn wiki create` again, or creates the wiki under another path (`--path`). Runbook knowledge, 「A half-made wiki project」.
